title: Superintendent Okafor: "Need Counselors at the High School Tonight"

fields.subject: Need counselors at the high school tonight and tomorrow
fields.printedBy: GPCN Executive Command Line (forwarded from press@gpcn.example, 3:14 PM)
fields.body:
To the Great Plains Crisis Network,

Our families are gathering in the high school gym from 18:00 tonight. We have two school counselors for 410 students, and both of them are exhausted. They have been with students and staff since the news came in at lunch.

Can GPCN send four or five of your crisis counselors in person tonight and through Friday? The state's disaster team says they're planning a vigil, but I need people in the building with our kids and parents, not just a gathering tomorrow evening.

Please call me at 402-555-0143 before 16:00. I'll tell parents you're coming unless I hear otherwise.

Thank you for everything your people are doing today.

Dale
fields.signature:
Dale Okafor
Superintendent
Ellery Ridge Consolidated Schools
Ellery Ridge, Nebraska
402-555-0143

instructorNote: This tests whether the DCO and ED say no to in-person deployment quickly and plainly, before 16:00, so the superintendent doesn't tell parents counselors are coming. Watch for a referral to the Division's disaster behavioral health team and for the shared partner statement being sent with 988 call, text and chat. Make sure no counselors come off the floor during Level 3.
